zones.title: Account lookup
zones.body: Synthetic customers in ar_mock_customers: by VIN (in-car), then by phone number (IVR). Lab only; the real build is the CASE account search.

zones.title: PIN identification
zones.body: The account by customerRef (known caller) or by the normalised registration plate, then the four-digit PIN must match. Test-period stand-in until the identification rule is agreed (question 20).

panels.title: Mock CASE customer account
panels.body: Synthetic customers in ar_mock_customers (seeded by AR-90). Lookup: VIN, then phone number. Identify: the four-digit PIN on the account (pin column), anchored by customerRef for a known caller or by the registration plate for an unknown one; a test-period stand-in until the identification rule is agreed (question 20). Real build: CASE account search in place of the table reads.
